messages:
alex: Quick Q from today's all-hands: a few partners flagged timing issues that could impact bookings this quarter. Can we capture a one-paragraph status for leadership on each at-risk account and the single next action we need?

rachel: From Sales: short summary per ask (very terse):
- Brightlane: $420k ARR, blocker = SOC2 evidence + legal SLA alignment. Next action: provide SOC artifact packet + 1x exec call. Owner: rachel.
- Hestia Labs: $180k ARR, blocker = disputed integration fees via partner incentive. Next action: temporary fee waiver + updated partner commission note. Owner: rachel/tom.
- Meridian Solutions (renewal): $95k ARR, blocker = slow procurement due to new vendor onboarding. Next action: supply procurement packet + procurement contact intro. Owner: priya.

tom: Partner note: Hestia is coming through our channel partner NorthStar. NorthStar is asking for clearer margin language in our reseller agreement before they will prioritize POC resources. We can either (a) offer a short margin guarantee for 60 days or (b) offer onboarding credits. I recommend option (b) to preserve long-term pricing.

devon: Product implications: two asks affect roadmap slightly. Brightlane wants a small audit endpoint for token-level logs (privacy-safe) to speed SOC2 review 1 day spike. Hestia needs an integration adapter for their partner gateway (est ~3 dev days). If we do both immediately, it delays the routing perf improvements by ~1 sprint.

priya: Ops/Legal: I can assemble the procurement + vendor packet for Meridian today and loop procurement contact into the thread. For the reseller language, legal prefers to avoid guarantees that materially change T&C; credits are easier. I'll draft a short reseller addendum for review. ETA: end of day.

alex: Decision needed: prioritize revenue-protection work (Brightlane audit endpoint + Hestia adapter) or keep roadmap schedule. If leadership chooses revenue, we'll reallocate up to two full-time sprints from infra roadmap. Which do you want?

rachel: From revenue stance: prioritize revenue-protection. Brightlane is the biggest ARR at immediate risk and likely to churn if we stall. Recommend reallocate 2 sprints.

devon: If leadership confirms, I'll move tasks into current sprint and assign two engineers for Brightlane 48h spike + one for Hestia adapter next week. Estimated dev work: Brightlane spike = 1.5 engineer-days (to prototype endpoint) + 1 engineer-day for docs. Hestia adapter = 3 dev days.

alex: OK let's protect the quarter. Action items:
1) rachel: send Brightlane exec call invite + one-paragraph summary to their CISO (due today).
2) devon: start Brightlane audit endpoint spike (assign engineer, 48h).
3) tom/priya: draft reseller addendum and onboarding credits for NorthStar/Hestia (due EOD).
4) priya: procurement packet for Meridian (due today).
5) cadence-bot: schedule 30m standup for pipeline rescue tomorrow 09:30 PST.

cadence-bot: Calendar event created: "Pipeline rescue standup" 1: 2025-06-14 09:30 PST. Invitees: alex, rachel, tom, devon, priya. Link: https://calendar.internal/evt/pipe-2059123456

rachel: I'll send the Brightlane CISO note now and post the sent link here.

tom: I'll coordinate NorthStar and outline the credit structure; will post draft addendum by 16:00.

devon: Assigned engs and added tasks to sprint board: https://board.internal/sprints/42 (Brightlane task #3421, Hestia task #3422). I'll update status during standup.

priya: Procurement packet posted: https://docs.internal/procurement/meridian-2059123456. Dropped procurement contact into thread.

alex: Thanks team. Quick ask for the standup: bring the single-risk metric (probability of churn x ARR) so we can prioritize during the call. If anything changes before then, update this thread. :thumbsup:
